title: Composed supervisory control: Rate-of-change monitoring with latched trip -> Redundant sensor fusion with plausibility and rate trip

inputs.name: A_MaxRise
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Maximum permitted positive change per scan

inputs.name: A_MaxFall
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Maximum permitted negative change magnitude per scan

inputs.name: B_MaxRate
inputs.description: Subsystem B: Maximum accepted per-scan change

outputs.name: A_Delta
outputs.description: Subsystem A: Current minus previous value

outputs.name: A_Ready
outputs.description: Subsystem A: A previous enabled sample exists

outputs.name: B_Degraded
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Only one sensor is used

outputs.name: B_Disagree
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Both valid sensors disagree

outputs.name: B_RateTrip
outputs.description: Subsystem B: Latched excessive rate change

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: Subsystem A: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem A: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem A: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A: A_MaxRise and A_MaxFall are non-negative and remain constant during a test.
Subsystem B: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Subsystem B: Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Subsystem B: Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: The first enabled sample shall initialize history, set A_Ready, and shall not A_Trip.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: For subsequent enabled samples, A_Delta shall equal A_Value minus the A_Previous enabled A_Value.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A A_Delta above A_MaxRise or below negative A_MaxFall shall latch A_Trip.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Trip shall remain set until A_Reset occurs while A_Enable is FALSE.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Disabling monitoring shall clear A_Ready but shall not by itself clear A_Trip.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When both sensors are valid and their absolute difference is at most B_MaxDifference, the B_Candidate value is their average.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When exactly one sensor is valid, the B_Candidate is that sensor and B_Degraded is TRUE.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: When both valid sensors differ by more than B_MaxDifference, B_Disagree is TRUE and B_ValidOutput is FALSE.

While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: After initialization, an otherwise valid B_Candidate changing by more than B_MaxRate shall latch B_RateTrip and shall not replace B_ProcessValue.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Ready AND candidate_valid AND abs(B_Candidate-prev(B_ProcessValue))>B_MaxRate)->(B_RateTrip AND B_ProcessValue=prev(B_ProcessValue))))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_RateTrip or B_Enable FALSE shall force B_ValidOutput FALSE; B_Reset clears B_RateTrip only while disabled.
requirements.property: G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_RateTrip OR !B_Enable)->!B_ValidOutput)) AND G((SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady) -> ((B_Reset AND !B_Enable)->!B_RateTrip))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: At equality boundaries for B_MaxDifference and B_MaxRate, the B_Candidate remains acceptable.
A TRUE A_Trip shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
requirements.property: G(CrossReset -> (!CrossReady AND B_ProcessValue=0.0 AND NOT B_ValidOutput AND NOT B_Degraded AND NOT B_Disagree AND NOT B_RateTrip)) AND G((NOT (SubsystemBEnable AND CrossReady)) -> (B_ProcessValue=0.0 AND NOT B_ValidOutput AND NOT B_Degraded AND NOT B_Disagree AND NOT B_RateTrip))

requirements.text: Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
